correctness.rationale: The source theorem gives exactly two finite-return endpoint forms. The address map has affine prefix slope (-1/2)^k. For even k, beta=w beta and L=w alpha, yielding b-b_*=2^{-k}(b-a). For odd k, beta=w alpha and L=w^infinity; the fixed-point equation b_*=A_w-2^{-k}b_* together with b=A_w-2^{-k}a yields b-b_*=(b-a)/(2^k+1). The k=infinity case is the source singleton. All hypotheses, parity cases, and endpoint-coding limitations are stated, and no computation is used as an infinite proof.
